name: Cream of Asparagus Soup
description: A creamy and smooth asparagus soup made with canned asparagus, perfect for serving year-round with optional fresh garnishes.
recipeIngredient: 2 (12 oz) cans asparagus tips or cuttings

recipeInstructions.text: Chop onions and celery medium fine and sauté in butter until limp but not brown.
Add flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually add chicken stock (dissolve bouillon cubes in water) and stir until smooth.
Bring to a boil, then add canned asparagus including liquid and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.
Purée the soup in a blender and press through a sieve for a smooth texture.
To serve, bring soup to a boil, remove from heat, and stir in whipping cream.
Season to taste and keep warm over low heat without boiling.

keywords: asparagus soup, creamy soup, canned asparagus

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
_similar.description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
_similar.recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.
